description: The view from the flat (27th floor, Tel Aviv): city-pano.jpg = 180° of city (west -> north -> east) down to the balcony railing (~ -9.5°), rows linear in tan(elevation): tan +0.2 at the top, 1304 px per unit tan (horizon at row 261), built from crops of the survey photos 20261027_160717/160719/160720 (balcony); city-pano-alpha.jpg = its skyline mask; city-ground.jpg = self-made procedural rooftops seen from above (200 x 200 m tile: flat light roofs, solar water heaters, street trees); facade-stone.jpg / facade-glass.jpg = self-made procedural facades for the two nearby towers seen in 160703/160717 and 160659/160723.
